items.title: UN relief chief 'appalled' by killing of aid worker in South Sudan
items.description: Tom Fletcher warns 42 humanitarians have died in the country since January as GOAL Global demands an investigation
items.author: Yasin Gungor
items.excerpt: UN relief chief Tom Fletcher said Friday he is "appalled" by the fatal attack on an aid worker in South Sudan's Upper Nile State. "All parties must ensure aid workers can do their work safely," UN Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs Fletcher wrote on US social media company X. He warned 42 humanitarians have been killed in the country since January and offered condolences to the victim's family and friends. Humanitarian agency GOAL Global confirmed Thursday that one of its staff members died in the incident, calling the attack "unacceptable" and urging authorities to investigate.
